evidence_snippets: Spanner Graph is based on two ISO standards: ISO/IEC 9075-16:2023 - Information technology — Database languages SQL Property Graph Queries (SQL/PGQ) , Edition 1, 2023 ISO/IEC 39075:2024 - Information technology — Database languages — GQL , Edition 1, 2024 The following tables describe the high-level relationship between SQL/PGQ, GQL, and how Spanner Graph supports these standards.
